title: Imp Jar & Zeus Bolt Vanilla Custard 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Vanilla Custard by Imp Jar and Zeus Juice is an exquisite rendition of the classic dessert, offering the creamy, rich taste of vanilla custard that's as comforting as it is luxurious. This e-liquid provides a smooth, deeply satisfying vape, capturing the essence of vanilla with a creamy backdrop that envelops the senses. This e-liquid is a testament to simple, perfected pleasures, making it a delightful treat at any time. Joining forces, Imp Jar's balanced 50/50 e-liquids and Zeus Juice's exceptional flavour craftsmanship result in a versatile e-liquid suitable for various vaping devices. Whether you prefer pod systems or starter kits, this 50PG/50VG blend offers an ideal vaping experience with ample flavour and cloud production. Each 60ml shortfill bottle contains 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, plus 10ml space for a nicotine shot. Adding a 10ml, 18mg nicotine shot creates 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, allowing for personalized nicotine strength. It's a perfect option for those seeking both high-quality flavour and the flexibility to adjust nicotine content.
